name: Fence workshop yard
concept: Saint-Philippe's motor and scrap workshop, 1989: the vanilla Workshop_01_Main (b33) with Workshop_01_Side (b36) as the annex behind it, fitted whole. The front is a working yard: an open bay with workbenches, a vice, tyres, fuel drums and a parts counter, the mechanic's office and WC to one side. The fence's trade is hidden: the annex behind the bay is a back room reached through the workshop, where the fence (LF_Fence) buys and sells over a stall. Nothing on the street, the sign or the public map says fence (D-M5); the yard reads as a garage to anyone walking past.

annex.why: b36 relative to b33 in the main building's space, pushed 0.16 m back to clear the main's back wall collider

rooms.role: the open workshop bay behind the industrial door: workbenches, vice, tyre pile, fuel drums, the concrete mixer; the public face of the yard
the mechanic's office and parts counter by the front door: card files, wall map, crates
washroom and coat hooks: sink, mirror, towel rack, first-aid box
the fence's back room in the annex: the stall, the fence NPC, the stove and the armchair; never signed, never on the map

interactables: fence stall (LF_FenceStall.et, back room; LF_FenceSerials books what it sells)
front: no public interactable beyond the vanilla doors
map: No public map marker or sign names the fence (D-M5). The street sign, if any, names the garage.
